scope: One disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster, one ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, two separately addressable case-owned HTTPS backends on distinct workers behind one ClusterIP Service, and short-lived synthetic CA and server certificates. Only CREATE requests for named ConfigMaps in saf-test are matched, and all probes use server dry-run. The case checks an untrusted CA rejection with ordinary API continuity, staged CA overlap while rotating each backend certificate, direct API-server verification of each backend identity, and admission through the shared Service after one backend leaves its endpoints, a PodDisruptionBudget for the last healthy backend, and native latency instrumentation. It does not establish production automated renewal, secret distribution, topology governance, managed control-plane behavior, sustained availability, or production change controls.

checks.claim: The live admission comparison runs on Kubernetes v1.36.1
Two ready webhook backends run on distinct workers
The originally trusted webhook serves the selected admission request
Untrusted webhook CA rejects matching dry-run at TLS
Ordinary API reads continue while matching webhook trust is wrong

Renewed backend b serves admission with only the new CA
